name: at-ussd-reply-01-E160
note: at-ussd-reply: ATGEN_ReplyGetUSSD must return ERR_NONE and the printed decoded response must NOT match 'Response: (00[A-Fa-f0-0]*)?\n' (i.e. text decoded, not empty and not left as UCS2 hex). Decoded text and status are not asserted. Charset = +CSCS in effect (U prefix => UCS2 else GSM); DCS in line (15 = GSM7, 72 = UCS2, 17 = UCS2 w/ language) decides packing. E160 sends unquoted 7-bit packed hex without DCS (Huawei quirk).
